What to compare

Factor What to check Why it matters
Reach Place both players at their real positions One person should not cross the other’s controls
Key grouping Map each player’s documented controls before starting Separated clusters reduce accidental presses
Rollover Test expected simultaneous key combinations Some boards block particular combinations
Cable and board stability Check movement when the device changes hands A sliding keyboard disrupts shared play

Test the current setup first

Compare the tradeoffs

For keyboard for two-player shared device, compare one change at a time. Start with reach: place both players at their real positions. Then check key grouping, because separated clusters reduce accidental presses. During the keyboard for two-player shared device comparison, keep the same game, page, room, and device so the result is easier to attribute.

The remaining checks cover rollover and cable and board stability. Some boards block particular combinations. A sliding keyboard disrupts shared play.
